patches.description: Replaces a hexadecimal patterns of bytes of files in an APK.
patches.name: Hex

options.description:
Hexadecimal patterns to search for and replace with another in a target file.

A pattern is a sequence of case insensitive strings, each representing hexadecimal bytes, separated by spaces.
An example pattern is 'aa 01 02 FF'.

Every pattern must be followed by a pipe ('|'), the replacement pattern,
another pipe ('|'), and the path to the file to make the changes in relative to the APK root. 
The replacement pattern must have the same length as the original pattern.

Full example of a valid input:
'aa 01 02 FF|00 00 00 00|path/to/file'
options.title: Replacements

options.description: Can be a hex color (#AARRGGBB) or a color resource reference.
options.title: Dark theme background color

options.description: Can be a hex color (#AARRGGBB) or a color resource reference.
options.title: Light theme background color

patches.description: Unlocks the ability to download any video. GIFs can be downloaded via the menu on long press.
patches.name: Unlock downloads

patches.description: Unlocks the premium Reddit icons.
patches.name: Unlock premium Reddit icons

patches.description: Unlocks the subscription feature but requires a custom client ID.
patches.name: Unlock subscription

patches.description: Unlocks "Routes", "Matched Runs" and "Segment Efforts".
patches.name: Unlock subscription features

patches.description: Unlocks all themes that are inaccessible until a certain level is reached.
patches.name: Unlock themes

patches.description: Replaces the deprecated endpoint for viewing user profiles /u with /user, that used to fix a bug.
patches.name: Use /user/ endpoint

patches.description: Adds an option to remove ads in the video player.
patches.name: Video ads

patches.description: Adds options to use the advanced video quality menu and set default video qualities.
patches.name: Video quality

patches.description: Adds an option to replace the search icon with a wide search bar. This will hide the YouTube logo when active.
patches.name: Wide searchbar
